# Paper Sky

The market, one paper chapter a day. Real keyless market data, ELI5 explanations, an honest simulated ledger, and a humorous Sky note that is never a signal. Paper trading only — no real orders, no investment advice.

## Entry points
- [Today](/): five measurements, verdict, ledger, news, tomorrow hook
- [Chapter 1](/journal/2026-11-25/): full analysis
- [RSI](/notes/rsi/): oversold is a condition, not a trigger
- [RWA](/notes/rwa/): tokenised real-world assets and what RWA TVL measures
- [Funding](/notes/funding/): perpetual funding and crowded positioning
- [DXY](/notes/dxy/): the dollar backpack
- [Fear and Greed](/notes/fear-greed/): mood ring, not compass
- [Methodology](/methodology/): data sources, risk rules, cookies
- [Archive](/archive/): all chapters
- [RSS](/rss.xml): feed

## Cross-project
- [Sky Chapter](https://skychapter.sok.lv/): the real sky, one chapter a day

## Disclaimer
Informational and entertainment only. Simulated decisions; no broker connection; not investment advice.
